_what: Per-session BEHAVIOUR PROFILE. Read fresh by goal-guard.py on EVERY hook call, so an edit here changes live sessions with no restart. A session picks its lane with CLAUDE_LANE=<name>; unset means 'default'.
_founder_asks_2026_08_21: keep agents goal and outcome oriented / so they dont get too sidetracked and into rabbit holes / and when they do can work their way back to objectives / how to instill best practices awareness as first principle / what not to do, shortest and most efficient path / increasing throughput / how to encourage researching better and more efficient ways / take ownership in platform improvement / proactive not passive / so different lanes / fully configurable from ops dashboard

_fields.goal_required: session must have a goal on disk before it works
_fields.readonly_run_limit: consecutive PROVABLY read-only tool calls before the walk-back fires. 0 = off. NOT a measured number yet -- see _threshold_provenance.
_fields.research_budget_calls: recon calls allowed before a decision must be made. 0 = off, not yet enforced.
_fields.proactive: when idle, claim an item off the improvement queue instead of waiting.
_fields.close_condition: the turn may not end without DONE:/BLOCKED:.

_threshold_provenance: 25 is a STARTING VALUE, not a measurement. The only numbers we have describe how bad drift gets, not where it begins: across 10 sessions / 36h / 22,395 tool calls the worst read-only run was 1017 and the median worst-run was 391. Every firing writes a goal_drift line to ~/.claude/state/ledger.jsonl, so the real number is measurable in a week and this default replaced by one.

build._for: shipping a specific change. Tight rein: reading is a means, not the work.

research._for: a question whose answer is not on this machine. Reading IS the work, so the rein is long -- but not infinite, because 1017 happened inside a session that believed exactly that.

incident._for: LAW 1 is open. The objective has a number in it and nothing else is legal.

platform._for: founder ask: 'what take ownership in platform improvement', 'proactive not passive'. No externally-set goal, so the session claims one.
